description: This file defines functions to trigger webhooks for recording readiness and transcription generation events, including fetching relevant webhooks, constructing payloads, and handling errors.

methods.name: getWebhooksByEventTrigger
methods.description: Fetches webhooks based on event trigger and booking details.

methods.name: triggerRecordingReadyWebhook
methods.description: Triggers webhooks when a recording is ready, sending relevant event data.

methods.name: triggerTranscriptionGeneratedWebhook
methods.description: Triggers webhooks when a transcription is generated, sending relevant event data.
